## 🐞 What kind of problem is it?
<!-- Mark one with an x, like [x]. -->
- [ ] **Bug**: broken link, search, diagram or page that won't load
- [ ] **Wrong content**: a fact, exam tip or code sample is incorrect
- [ ] **Outdated content**: Microsoft Fabric or the exam has changed
- [ ] **Device issue**: displays or behaves badly on a specific device or browser
- [ ] **Something else**
